scope: Layout CPU work used by window/tab opening, closing, selection, moving, resizing, and view/space switching.

changes.change: Skip unused minimum-size and weight computation for explicit stacks; avoid weight-key strings when no weights exist and resolve saved weights once.
Use recursive membership checks rather than allocating flattened leaf arrays during selection and workspace lookup.
Reuse browser owner resolution during minimum-size lookup, avoid match arrays, reuse the live tree for fullscreen planning, and instrument shared layout planning.
Skip live projections when no native owner requests fullscreen; presentation reads no longer create empty native containers.

app_full_suite.note: Settings files were already modified on entry and continued changing during the audit; none were edited by this performance pass.

settings_isolated_rerun.note: Passed on isolated rerun after concurrent settings-source edits; the performance pass did not modify settings code.

limitations: Synthetic CPU timings are not measurements of rendered frame rate or end-to-end interaction latency.
